field.label: Enabled
field.help: A disabled chain is kept in the list but is not written to config.json.

field.label: Name
field.help: Shown in the routing rules under «Chains» in Target Outbound.

field.label: Hop 1 (entry)
field.help: The first node the traffic goes to. Pick enabled nodes only.

field.label: Hop 2
field.help: The next node: the connection to it goes through hop 1. With two hops this is the exit node, the one that connects to the Internet.

field.label: Hop 3
field.help: Optional. Leave empty if the chain ends at hop 2.

field.label: Hop 4
field.help: Optional. Fill only if hop 3 is filled.

field.label: Hop 5
field.help: Optional. The last filled hop is the exit node. Stream-based nodes (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks) are the safe choice for hops; check that WireGuard or MASQUE nodes work as a hop before relying on them.
